title: Addressing Manpower Shortage in Biotech Sector
what_it_is: Addressing Manpower Shortage in Biotech Sector

sections.label: Biomedical talent and biotech programmes
sections.summary: A*STAR has nurtured 560 PhD-level talents and has 250 scholars, with biotech admissions rising from 1,200 in 2018 to 1,400 in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: A*STAR has nurtured a pool of 560 PhD-level talents for biomedical-related sectors to-date, including the biotech sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In addition, we have a pipeline of 250 A*STAR scholars who are currently pursuing biomedical-related fields of study.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The number of students admitted to biotech disciplines in our Autonomous Universities has grown from 1,200 in 2018 to 1,400 in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We do this through efforts like the SGInnovate’s Helix Immersion Programme and the A*STAR’s Singapore Therapeutics Development Review (STDR) initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: There is also the Innovation and Enterprise Fellowship Programme (IFP) which has attracted more than 90 fellows since its launch in 2020 and has seen 50 deep-tech startups, accelerators and incubators participate in its pilot.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: T-Up is the Technology for Enterprise Capability Upgrading programme, which has seconded close to 70 researchers and scientists to 45 biotech-related companies.

sections.label: Growth in biotech companies
sections.summary: Singapore has tripled biotech-related companies from a decade ago, with about 140 companies in therapeutics, diagnostics and drug delivery.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Today, we have tripled the number of companies in biotech related areas compared to a decade ago.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: We have about 140 companies in Singapore involved in therapeutics, diagnostics, drug delivery as well as drug delivery tools.

sections.label: STDR therapeutics project funding
sections.summary: Between 2015 and 2021, STDR funded 44 therapeutics projects over seven grant calls, of which 18 were completed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The Member may be interested to know that between 2015 to 2021 STDR has funded 44 therapeutics projects over seven grant calls, of which 18 projects have been completed.

sections.label: Deep Tech Talent Central launch
sections.summary: By 2025 the programme will place-and-train some 100 fellows in biotech startups and companies, and Deep Tech Talent Central launched on 13 January.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: By year 2025, this programme will place-and-train some 100 fellows in bio-tech startups and companies and more recently, just last month, on 13 January, we launched the Deep Tech Talent Central and this is led by SGInnovate and supported by the private and public sector partners.
